name: Helm's Bed Lake
summary: In southeastern Dun Morogh, Helm's Bed Lake lies frozen beneath the hills. Dwarves keep a hole open in its ice for fresh water, while beasts, troggs, and hostile Dark Iron dwarves threaten the shore.

sections.title: A Treacherous Shoreline
sections.body: Helm's Bed Lake lies beneath winter ice in southeastern Dun Morogh. Local dwarves keep an opening chopped through the frost so they can draw clean, fresh water. The frozen surface is stable enough to cross, but the banks are dangerous. Wild beasts roam the edges, displaced troggs scavenge along the ridges, and hostile Dark Iron dwarves have taken an abandoned lodge just south of the water. They ambush travelers who pass through.

faq.q: Why is there an open hole in the middle of the frozen lake?
faq.answer: Local dwarves keep a hole open in the thick ice so they can reach fresh, unfrozen water throughout Dun Morogh's sub-zero climate.

faq.q: What dangers lurk around Helm's Bed Lake?
faq.answer: The solid lake surface is safe to cross, but predatory beasts and stray troggs prowl its perimeter. South of the water, hostile Dark Iron dwarves occupy an old building and violently repel anyone who draws near.

aliases: dead body at helms bed lake
faq.answer: Narm Faulk is an unfortunate dwarf whose body lies along Helm's Bed Lake's shoreline. He is a grim casualty of the sudden surge of hostile threats and Dark Iron infiltrators in the area.

faq.q: Are the Dark Iron dwarves officially occupying the lake?
faq.answer: The Dark Iron dwarves have not seized the lake, but an armed squad has claimed an abandoned structure just south of it. They use the building as a forward position to stage skirmishes into central Dun Morogh.

angles.text: As a dwarf of Ironforge, you know Helm's Bed Lake as a vital source of fresh water and a security failure. Dark Iron saboteurs and troggs are pushing deeper into Dun Morogh's heartland.
As an Alliance traveler heading east toward Loch Modan, stay alert. The southward trail skirts close to aggressive Dark Iron ambushes.
